facts.what: Ethan 把创伤性僵直的 Sarah 抱上床守着，用手语对 Gage 说她若崩溃，我也崩溃；Harmony 送来水和水果，还说注意到他们的手语诡异但迷人。
facts.anchor: Ethan sighed. Then his hands moved, telling me, “If she breaks, I break.”

facts.what: Seb 在楼梯口对 Gage 哭诉：Blue 死时我的一部分也随她而去了，并请求 Gage 不要怪他盼望自己死去的那一天。
facts.anchor: The saddest tears fell from Seb’s eyes onto the stair below. “A part of me left with her when she died.”

facts.what: Sarah 向 Ethan 讲出创伤源头：当年小学枪击案开枪的是她父亲，他射杀了几名同学、走到她课桌前却停住、盯着她看后转身离开。
facts.anchor: It was my father, Ethan. He was the one with the gun.

facts.what: Gage 点明当天正是那起校园枪击案的周年纪念日；Sarah 补述枪手（她父亲）随后回家杀死妻子再自杀。
facts.anchor: Today was the anniversary of a school shooting, and I didn’t think there could be anything worse in the world.

facts.what: Ethan 对 Sarah 说我们真是一对：两人都有试图杀死他们的父亲，两位父亲还都害死了他们的母亲。
facts.anchor: What a pair we make. Both with fathers who tried to kill us. Both with fathers who succeeded with our mothers.

facts.what: Ethan 吻 Sarah 头发时默念 Beloved——那是他祖父母之间的爱称，两位老人结婚超过六十年、在他年幼时相继去世。
facts.anchor: It was an endearment he used to hear his grandparents call one another. They had been married for over sixty years

facts.what: 守夜仪式上 Ethan 把 Blue 的大幅画像藏进唱诗袍偷走给 Seb，低声说我替你看住她了，安静点。
facts.anchor: Ethan slid the portrait under his robe as if there was nothing to see. To Seb, he whispered, “I got your girl. Now chill.”

facts.what: Gage、Finn、Ethan、Seb 四人认定牧师的新 Mercedes 用的是 Blue 的捐款，一起朝车撒尿，Gage 特意尿了门把手。
facts.anchor: Four angry penises were whipped out and happily pissed all over the car we were sure Blue’s donations were paying for.
